config.minersmarket.title: Miner's Market Settings
Sales amount required for a player to finish the game.
config.minersmarket.option.countdown_sec: Countdown length in seconds before the game starts.
config.minersmarket.option.interval_seco: Seconds to wait after one price event ends before the next one can start.
config.minersmarket.option.duration_min_: Minimum duration of a price event in seconds.
config.minersmarket.option.duration_max_: Maximum duration of a price event in seconds (must be >= the minimum).
config.minersmarket.option.change_min_pe: Minimum price change as a percentage.
config.minersmarket.option.change_max_pe: Maximum price change as a percentage (must be >= the minimum).
config.minersmarket.option.starter_enabl: If ON, the market chest is filled with starting equipment.
Number of players to equip (each gets one pickaxe and one bread stack).
config.minersmarket.option.bread_count.t: Number of bread items per stack.
config.minersmarket.option.pickaxe_fortu: Fortune enchantment level on the starter pickaxes (0 disables the enchantment).
config.minersmarket.option.generate_on_w: If ON, the market is generated when an Overworld is loaded and no market exists yet.
config.minersmarket.note_local: Local settings: applied to worlds you host.
config.minersmarket.note_not_host: Not the host: changes won't affect this world.
